answer: A juror that skips cases loses 39% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the canyon decay is applied at each close, the comet audit reveals the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the raven fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 3 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
